A Newsweek analysis compares Trump's approval rating on August 31, 2026, with where it stood when he returned to office on January 20, 2025, with net approval calculated as approve minus disapprove.

#### Read More on Politics

Nationally, Trump stands at 35 percent approval and 59 percent disapproval, leaving him with a net approval rating of minus 24. [...] Younger voters remain Trump's weakest group. Among adults aged 18 to 34, just 22 percent approve of his job performance while 70 percent disapprove.

Among voters aged 35 to 49, approval stands at 28 percent and disapproval at 63 percent.

Independents also remain firmly negative, with 29 percent approving and 62 percent disapproving. W

# Donald Trump's job approval falls to 33%

August 11, 2026

Only one-third (33%) of Americans strongly or somewhat approve of how Donald Trump is handling his job as president, according to the latest Economist / YouGov Poll. That's the smallest share to ever approve of Trump's job handling in any Economist / YouGov Poll across both of Trump's terms. Meanwhile 62% disapprove of Trump, the most to ever do so.
